newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Nov 4.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Nov 4.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Singapore bunker quotes remained unchanged on stable cargo prices, traders said. They said prices have remained stable despite crude gains which showed that the market is soft. A major said he sold two parcels of 380 cst - of 400 tonnes and 500 tonnes - at $115.50 per tonne. Traders said the market was thin, dampened further by a Japanese holiday. MDO and gasoil prices edged slightly higher on demand.-- Singapore Newsoom (65-870-3082).
